programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: We show what's hot and what's not in the car world. This time we focus on the fastest cars.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Real luxury, the kind of cars most people can only dream of. We present the most expensive production cars.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: We present the ten heaviest cars. But there are not only heavy bodies or big vans to see. We have a few surprises up our sleeves.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Day after day, the research and development departments of car manufacturers are working to make their upcoming models unique. We present the ten most unusual cars of the last few years.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: The 24-hour race at Germany's Nürburgring is one of the most famous and dangerous endurance races in the world. We show those cars that have won the most titles.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Fuel prices continue to rise. That's why in this episode we present ten of the most fuel-efficient cars in the world.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: Peugeot released this classic, all wheel drive monster for one purpose only: It should bring the World Rally Championship to France. The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 shook up the rally world in the 80s.

programme.title: Mercedes Targa Florio Racing Car from 1924 Back on the Road
programme.desc: 100 years after Mercedes' triumph in the legendary endurance race Targa Florio in Sicily in 1924, a 2-liter racing car used at that time is returning to the road. Mercedes-Benz Classic has authentically restored the vehicle.

programme.title: Mercedes Targa Florio Racing Car from 1924 on a Road Trip Around the World
programme.desc: 100 years after the triumph in the legendary Targa Florio endurance race of 1924, a Mercedes race car from that era returns to the road. The faithfully restored vehicle embarks on a world road trip to the most spectacular events, from Pebble Beach to Goodwood.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Porsche Type 64
programme.desc: The Porsche 64 was developed in parallel with the Volkswagen Beetle by Ferdinand Porsche and his son Ferry. The streamlined racing car was designed to enter the long distance race from Berlin to Rome that never took place because of the war.

programme.title: Auto Union Type C Silver Arrow
programme.desc: Every two years, cars from the past once again roar on the streets of Monte Carlo. The pinnacle of motor sports from back then, the Silver Arrow with 16 cylinders, the Auto Union Type C, still commands the highest respect from drivers today.

programme.title: Tatra T 87
programme.desc: Avantgarde on four wheels. In its day, the 1937 Tatra T 87 was considered as a car of the future

programme.title: DKW F12 Roadster
programme.desc: More than 60 years ago, the managers and workers from Ingolstadt, Germany, presented the last car manufactured under the brand name DKW, the F12 Roadster.

programme.title: Borgward Isabella Convertible
programme.desc: The German „Miss“ Wonder: The Borgward Isabella Cabriolet counts as being one of the automotive rarities from Germany.

programme.title: Chrysler Airflow
programme.desc: The representative U.S. streamlined body was too far ahead of its time . A flop at the time - now a cult classic .

programme.title: Triumph 1800 Roadster
programme.desc: Cruising like in „Miss Marple“ times. The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster has space for 5 fresh air fans.

programme.title: Volkswagen Karmann Ghia with a Porsche Engine
programme.desc: Take a racy Volkswagen body and pumped full of Porsche engineering. Jochen Bader has done exactly that with his 1970 Karmann Ghia. A classical hybrid of the absolutely special kind.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: At the "Day of Thunder" in Magdeburg, Germany, two- and four-wheelers take part in Europe's most famous 1/8 mile race.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Already in the eighth season of the German Race Wars, visitors from over 20 countries make their pilgrimage to the big event. And: The Mini John Cooper Works is the racing version of the Bavarian racer. Arden turns it into the Arden Mini AM 3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: For BMW tuner Manhart Racing, the Nurburgring Nordschleife is the ideal place to celebrate its 25th anniversary. As part of the Track Days, customers and interested parties will have the opportunity to get to know the Manhart models.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Busca in the Piemonte region of Italy is the location of the fifth round of this year's competition.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: For Round 6, the S1GP of Nations, the teams head to Vysoké Mýto in the Czech Republic.

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider
programme.desc: Wir fahren mit dem McLaren 570S Spider ein wenig durchs Gebirge und geniessen den schönen Tag.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt coordinator Domi’s latest idea for the Stunt Heroes team involves an old ambulance that is prepared so that the stuntman can jump right through the ambulance with his car.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This time the team deals with motorbike stunts: high jumps, risky drops and dangerous crashes in the company's backyard. Stunt coordinator Domi requires his specialists to be in top shape and extremely focused.

programme.title: Kymco People GT 300i
programme.desc: 10 or 16 inch wheels - is this really just a question of taste? Motorvision reveals the advantages and disadvantages of the big wheel motorcycle People GT 300i, made by Kymco.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Porsche packed a lot of power into the Panamera. We took their Sport Turismo model to the Formula One track in Bahrain. In addition: BMW redesigned their 530i Touring 4-cylinder station wagon. And: an trip to Cologne in the Volvo V60.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Beside SUVs, compact and city cars are on the rise. For many people, a Kia Picanto is enough to satisfy their mobility needs. In addition: the Audi A1 offers certain features of the luxury class, but at a much higher price. And: the agile Kia Ceed GT.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Cadillac CTS-V
programme.desc: Those who don’t know about it will only see a dignified sedan but under the hood hides the 649 horse power 6.2 liter V8 supercharged engine of the Corvette Z06. This car is a good alternative to the Audi RS6, BMW M5 and Mercedes E63 AMG.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Die-hard Porsche fan Marco Wendlandt makes his dream come true: driving a 1984 Porsche 911 coupe. With the help from Big Mike, a car dealer from Los Angeles, he tracks down the car in San Francisco.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: With his newly bought Porsche 911 coupe, Marco heads to L.A. to meet one of the best known Porsche enthusiasts of the world: Magnus Walker, who invites Marco to visit his workshop and his collection.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: On his way to Las Vegas Marco drops by Big Mike in the Apple Valley. Together they meet Big Mike's friends from the Kustos family, who once used to be trendsetters in the Californian car customizing scene.

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: BMW M3

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: McLaren is one of the most famous automobile brands from Great Britain. There are hardly any sports cars that fascinate as much as a McLaren or have such a legendary heritage in motorsports. Two recent models from McLaren are the 650S and the limited series P1. Supercars is in the mood for love and dates the McLaren 650S at an old industrial area and on the race track.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: There are details which set super cars apart from normal cars and these details are essential. Super cars are the biggest, loudest and most expensive cars on the highway; they're four-wheeled works of arts.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In celebration of its 100th anniversary, Maserati rewarded itself with a beautiful coupe called Maserati Alfiere. But that's not all. The company invites to a trip from Bologna to Turin featuring the most beautiful models from the last decades. Supercars takes part in this trip with a Granturismo MC Stradale.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It’s name is Mulsanne, Bentely Mulsanne. The new flagship from Bentley reaches a top speed of close to 300 km/h, it is luxurious like a first class hotel and elegant like an Armani suit. Supercars reveals how it feels like to ride a dream car like this. Plus: Supercars takes a look at the remarkable Rolls Royce Ghost and the high-tech coupé Mercedes S 63 AMG.

programme.title: Volvo XC60
programme.desc: The Swedish landscape is characterized by mountains, forests and lonely roads. Ideal for this off-roader. The Volvo XC60 scores with many safety features and a cool appearance.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The International Championship for Manufacturers was a rally series which was run from 1970 to 1972. Car manufacturers such as Porsche, Renault, Opel and Ford took part in this competition, with Ford having an exceptionally successful year in 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The compact cars Mercedes A45 AMG Performmaster and MTM Audi RS3 R are loud, fast and extremely honed. In addition we examine the myth of Ferrari and take a look behind the scenes of the Rolls Royce Bespoke production.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: With its Model S, American carmaker Tesla wants to establish electric engines in the full-size class. For the first time it is possible to attain driving ranges over 400 kilometers. And: with its Panamera Sport Turismo, Porsche taps into a new market.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: With the Toyota GT 86 from J-Sport, it is noticeable that the company's roots lie in racing. The fans' wish to give the Japanese racer significantly more power nevertheless remained unfulfilled.

programme.desc: This week, the team helps a buyer explore new and unfamiliar brands, finds a comfy SUV for rough roads, and compares the Toyota Starlet and Suzuki Baleno for trips.

From the jaw-dropping “Scrape Alley” limbo cars to a decade of community, competition and culture, the show highlights the passion, innovation and creativity driving SA’s custom car scene.

programme.title: Maserati Levante S
programme.desc: The Levante aims to be not just a Maserati SUV, but 'the Maserati of SUVs'.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: When Land Rover decided to end their production of the Defender after more than 60 years, a successor needed to be determined. Also: the SsangYong Rexton, the Jeep Renegade and our pick of the top 5 off-roaders.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Audi RS6 and the Mercedes E63 AMG are the two top sportsters among station wagons. Alpina came up with the B5 Twin Turbo, their BMW-based answer to the competition. Also: the agile Skoda Octavia Combi. And: the Jaguar XF Sportbrake.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The off-road specialists from Delta 4x4 turned a Volkswagen Amarok into their so-called Beast and challenged Toyota off-road expert Alexander Wohlfarth in his Toyota Hilux. Which one of these 4x4 powerhouses fares better?

programme.desc: The Cadillac Escalade at first seems like a typical rather beefy American car, but this luxurious SUV is more of a lovable, gentle giant, that should be able to gain sympathy with its clientele.

programme.title: Seat Alhambra
programme.desc: Although the Seat Alhambra doesn’t look particularly sporty, but when tested by two professional bikers, it shows that it is not to be underestimated.

As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Supercars

But is the new BMW i8 just an luxurious, avant-garde carrier of technology or can it already be considered as a serious sports car? Why should you pay double the price compared to the BMW M4? Why shouldn’t you buy a good looking BMW M5, which has the same price, but is more functional? Supercars reveals the answers.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 GTS is the latest model in the iconic 911 sports car range. With an output of 430 HP it closes the gap between the S model and the GT3. Supercars gets the chance to take a ride in the new Porsche 911 GTS in California. Plus: The Roding Roadster is a small series lightweight sports car from Bavaria and uses technology from BMW under its bonnet.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: These days there's hardly a car manufacturer who doesn¿t build any kind of SUV. Three of the sportiest SUVs on the market are the Porsche Macan Turbo, Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and Audi RSQ3. Each of them comes with more than 300 HP; they are well prepared for any season and have ambitions to be sports car. Supercars finds out, if they have what it takes to be a sports car.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 99: Last Man Standing
programme.desc: The year-long, five-event tournament kicks off at GLORY 99 in Rotterdam Ahoy, featuring 32 heavyweights in 16 bouts on a mega all-heavyweight card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 98 Rotterdam
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 99: Last Man Standing
programme.desc: The year-long, five-event tournament kicks off at GLORY 99 in Rotterdam Ahoy, featuring 32 heavyweights in 16 bouts on a mega all-heavyweight card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 100 Last Heavyweight Standing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 6 Istanbul
programme.desc: GLORY makes it's debut in Turkey with GLORY 6: Istanbul. The main event features a super fight between Gokhan Saki against Daniel Ghiță. The event features 14 more fights with the likes of Joseph Valtellini, Filip Verlinden, Nieky Holzken, and Fabiano Cyclone among others.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 100 Last Heavyweight Standing

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 101 Featherweight GP
programme.desc: Over the course of a year, twelve of the best GLORY featherweights will compete opposite twelve of the best RISE featherweights in a series of knockout bouts until one fighter becomes the Last Featherweight Standing.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 102 Featherweight Grand Prix
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 103 Rotterdam LHS
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 105: Last Heavyweight Standing Finals
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 97 Featherweight Grand Prix
programme.desc: Eight of the best and most exciting featherweights on the planet go head-to-head in a one-night tournament. GLORY featherweight champion Petch (170-40-3, 27 KO) goes up against former RISE champion Taiju Shiratori (30-10-1, 12 KO), the in-form Berjan Peposhi (30-4, 16 KO) takes on ‘The Korean Monster’ Sunghyun Lee (69-11-2, 17 KO), the always exciting Abraham Vidales (16-3, 13 KO) collides with current RISE champ Chadd Collins (63-17-2, 32 KO), and number one ranked GLORY featherweight Miguel Trindade (59-6, 24 KO) faces RISE great & former GLORY title contender Kento Haraguchi (26-4-1, 17 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 106: Last FW Standing Quarter Finals
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 93 Rotterdam
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

Also in this episode Mikhail Gencer of Turkey takes on Liang Lo of Germany in a Lightweight bout and Leon Machere takes to the ring with Cem TV in a boxing match between two social media influencers.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 428 - Clan Wars 51 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. In a bantamweight contest, Ronan Deegan faces Adrian Barrow and Kelsey Crossey is matched up agains Jason McCourtney for a catchweight bout. In a match for the vacant featherweight Clan Wars title, Jede Paulo fights Nathan Chambers for the belt.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 435 - Clan Wars 51 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 3 from Belfast, Ireland. Ash Williams and Ciaran Mullholand take to the cage while Kian McCarton takes on Billy Sutherland for the Flyweight title. In the main event Lethal Shea Leathem challenges Jamie the Spider Monkey McCaugherty in a Welterweight championship title fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 457 - Shamrock FC 368
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 368 from St. Louis. Up first in a female bout, Jett Bouckaert and Scarlet Mayfield take to the cage. Next watch as Arthur Jackson faces Emmanuel Primer and Billy Duncan takes on Jaylon Jones in the welterweight division. In the co-main event, Max Choriev looking to head to the UFC faces Anders Murray in what's expected to be a battle of attrition and Sam Paneitz, coming off haitus, takes on Dusty Little.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 459 - Real Fight Promotion 100
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Real Fight Promotion 100 from Ukraine. In this special centenial event RFP brings its viewers an exciting night of fights. First up Stanislav Bogush and Nazar Pryshliak faceoff in the flyweight division followed by Timofiy Mytkalyk versus Ruslan Danyliuk. Also Vyacheslav Vaseichuk and Andriy Dzioba square off. In the Grand Prix finals, the two remaing fighters Roman Bandrivchak and Stanislov Bogush vye for the championship.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 454 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In the flyweight division Daniel Labastida faces Zain Palacio, Pargev Khachatrian steps into the cage with Israel Salazar and Matthew Ingram takes on Arshag Dadourian. In the main event, with the UNF welterweight title on the line Anthony Desimon looks to take the belt from Christopher London.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 460 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California with a night of great action. In the Rising Stars Flyweight division, Tommy Maurice and Jarred Turner face off plus Ian Miller and Adam Halton head to the ring in a bantam weight bout of boxing versus muay thai specialists. Up next, Drake Flores and Jose Hernandez face off in what's expected to be a dynamic clash. In the main event it's champion versus champion as Interim Lightweight champion Izac Enriquez takes on the returning champ Jairee Baker.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 461 - CMH Boxing II part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing II part 1 from Los Angeles California. This episode features a super lightweight bout between Adrien Boler and Benji Gomez in a match between youth and experience. Also featured, is the vacant WBC women's international light flyweight title fight as Brook Sibrian and Gloria Munguilla step into the ring for a rematch with Sibrian looking for redemption from their previous slugfest.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 462 - Shamrock FC 369
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 369 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In this episode Kylen Snider takes on Ryan Richmond and Cedric Vinson faces Blake Alan. Hometown favorite Anthony Dooley "The Stormin' Morman" takes on Nick Maxwell. In the co-main event BJJ blackbelt James Regina steps into the cage with undefeated Mike Boyle looking to keep his win streak alive and in the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on Andrew Horowitz in what could be Hicks' last fight in the cage,

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 464 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California, for an episode packed with action. In a battle of the Big Island Hawaii, Jake Babian and Kealii Kanekoa step into the cage in the welterweight division while the Somali Sniper Shafii Farah takes on Kester Abad in a flyweight battle.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 349 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 1 from Bucharest Romania. Watch four kickboxing battles on this episode of UFA. Starting out The Ironman, Denis Ceausu takes on Marius Cimpoeru, then Ali Gokturk Benli faces Andrei Leustean in a Turkey versus Romania bout. Florentin Ionescu takes on the more experienced Mihai Zmarandescu and Omer Pisgin takes on fan favorite The Shephard, Bogdan Nastase.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 350 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 2 from Bucharest Romania with a night of Kickboxing action. Starting off in the heavyweight division, Poland's Dominik Jedrejczyk takes on Romania's Claudiu Badoi in a David versus Goliath fight. Next up, Stefan Orza and Eduard Gafencu look to give fans a fight of the night. In two heavyweight matchups, Florin Ivanoaie faces Cristian Ristea and Ionut Iancu faces Sebastian Cozmanca.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 372 - Dynamite Fighting Show 22 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 22 part 1 from Romania. Watch as Andrei Varga "The Bonecrusher" faces Adrian Maxim in a youth versus expierence bout where the winner will move on in the tournament. Also fighting to stay in the tournament are Darius Argyo and Valentin Mavrodin, Marius Cimpoieru ("Berzerk") and Marian Lapusneanu ("The Terror") and in the fourth quarterfinal fight Costel Schiopu versus Alex Bublea.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 373 - Dynamite Fighting Show 22 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 22 part 2 from Romania. The quarterfinalist winners move on to fight in the championship tournament. The tournament fighters are Andrei Varga v Adrian Maxim, Darius Argyo v Valentin Mavrodin, Marius Cimpoieru v Marian Lapusneanu, Costel Schiopu v Alex Bublea. Also in this episode, a heavyweight fight between Brian Douwes and Ionut Iancu while Omar Ezekiel Moreno and Andrei Ostrovanu vie for the ISKA Super Middleweight Championship Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 383 - Dynamite Fighting Show 23 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 23 "Descendant's of Dracula" part 1 from Bistrita, Romania, the gateway of Transylvania. First up with the kickboxing action are the young Marciano Aerts facing the more experienced Vasile Cotelea, undefeated Paul Danci steps into the ring with David Anton while in the cruiserweight division Marius Rotaru and Ionut Busuioc face off.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 384 - Dynamite Fighting Show 23 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 23 "Descendant's of Dracula" part 2 from Bistrita, Romania, the gateway of Transylvania. In this episode fighters Andrei Leustean, Costin Dinu, Alexandru Andreescu and Andrei Ostrovanu battle for the title in a four man light heavyweight tournament. Also watch Andrei Varga and Bogdan Suru take to the ring for a much anticipated kickboxing contest.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 385 - Dynamite Fighting Show 23 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 23 "Descendant's of Dracula" part 3 from Bistrita, Romania, the gateway of Transylvania. In this episode, Sandor Kertesz faces Marius Munteanu in a heavyweight kickboxing match while veteran fighters Alex Bublea, with 93 wins, takes on Calin Petrisor with 37 wins. In an ISKA intercontinental Title fight in the lightweight division, Morocco's Odris Ramzi takes on Romania's Ionut Popa for the belt. Also in this episode, Balazs Kiss is matched up against Sebastian Lutaniuc in the cruiserweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 402 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features an 8 man tournament in the cruiserweight division. The champion will face the challenger in the ISKA world cruiserweight championship. Fighting in the quarter finals are Alessio Sarbu vs Sebastian Lutaniuc, Becali Bodescu vs Marius Rotaru, Costi Mocany vs Danut Hurduc and Alex Virlan vs Ionut Busuioc.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 403 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2 from Targu Jiu, Romania. Continuining the 8 man tournament in the crusierweight division, this episode features the semi-finals. In a SuperFight open weight division bout Vajtan Shanava, Spanish champion for three consecutive years, steps into the ring with Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi, Romanian favorite with a record of 62 wins and 31 by KO.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 404 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. But first, stepping into the ring are Alexandros Chrysochoidis and Bogdan Nastase with 55 victories, face off in a Superfight in the light heavyweight division. Next up two champions, Calin Petrisor, the defending ISKA champion and Valentin Mavrodin the defending DFS champion take to the ring for a title fight with the ISKA and DFS belt unificaiton on the line in the middleweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 430- Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. Up first in the middle weight division Denis Ceausu faces Andrei Varga. In the open weight division with a huge weight differential Rodrigo Mineiro, kickboxing world champion takes on boxer Bogdan Bestea for a boxing versus kickboxing contest. Watch as Alex Leautaund of the Netherlands takes on Romania's Mihai Desrobitu in a cruiserweight boxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 433 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. First up, a Superfight in the welterweight division, Bogdan Floristean versus Ionel Balan. In the women's lightweight division Maria Nitescu takes on Andreea Cebuc to determine the Baddest Woman in Romania. Also on this episode in the open division Tibor Varga of Hungary steps into the ring with Romania's Bogdan Nastase in a David versus Goliath duel.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 437 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of boxing and kickboxing fights. In the welterweight division Vinicius Bereta takes on Valentin Mavrodin in a Brazil versus Romania bout. In the open weight division Tolea Ciumac steps into the ring with Valentin Lambagiu with 100 pounds and over 20 years difference between the two fighters for a David versus Goliath duel. In the main event, Portugal's Iuri Fernandes faces Romania's Bogdan Stoica, with a stunning 58 wins to his name, in the Heavyweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 456 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 1 from Transylvania, Romania. Starting off with a superfight in the lightweight division, Bogdan Floristean faces Ionut Popa and in the middleweight division, Dominik Horvath takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga. Also stepping into the cage are Brazilian Rodrigo Mineiro and Romanian Florin Lambagiu.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 458 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2 from Transylvania, Romania. In this episode Fernando Martin from Spain and Romania's Andrei Leustean face off in a super middleweight division bout. Next up the co-main event in the heavyweight division, Hungary's Sandor Kertesz takes on Romania's Bogan Stoica. In the main event USA's Omar Moreno steps into the ring with hometown favorite Andrei Ostravanu for a rematch in a supermiddleweight fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 468 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up in the light-heavyweight division, undefeated Paul Danci takes on Alex Andreescu. Next up undefeated Eric Bubuleandra versus Becali Bodescu face off in the cruiser-weight division. In a heavyweight bout Bogdan Besta steps into the ring with Vasile Corcodel who looks to remain undefeated against his significantly heavier opponent. The main event features a super-cruiserweight bout between Italy's Frank Kanate and Romania's Stean Latescu.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 469 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up, a bout in the cruiserweight division with Madalin Mogos versus Sebastian Lutaniuc. Achilles Karapiperis and Calin Petrisor "The KO Hunter" step into the ring to face off in a middleweight division fight. In an open weight entertainment fight Justitiarul De Berceni makes his professional debut against veteran fighter Tolea Ciumac "The Tiberian Bear." In the co-main event Netherland's Chris Baya faces Romania's Florin Lambagiu in a supermiddleweight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 480 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Up first in a kickboxing middleweight bout are Vitalie Matei and Calin Petrisor - the KO Hunter. The main event is a superfight boxing matchup, World Champion Flavius Biea takes on The Hyena Daniel Corbeanu.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 484 - Dynamite Fighting Show - Best of part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents The Best of Dynamite Fighting Show part 1 from Romania. In the first bout Damian Johansen from the Netherlands versus Andrei "The Bone Crusher" Varga from Romania face off in the middleweight division. Next up, a Superfight in the Open Division, Spain's Vajtan Shanava faces Romania's Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi. Stepping into the ring next for a boxing match are Gilson DaSilva from Brazil versus Florin Cardos from Romania. Also on this card, two Romanian's battle it out as the younger Sebastian Lutaniuv takes on the more experienced Marius Munteanu with 22 KO's.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Tadas Sinkevicius and Samandar Akhmadjonov head to the ring in an MMA contest. Also in this episode Davit Faroiani faces Benas Sorochovas in a kickboxing lighweight division match, Romanian Nicola Ixari gets in the ring with Lithuanian Mantas Rimsa and in a heavyweight MMA contest Nicola Gobus and Kristaps Zutis take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 375 - KOK 105 Riga Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings part 2 from Riga, Latvia. Starting us off Jakub Kwasniewski and Eduard Mishin battle it out in kickboxing contest. In the co-main event, Guillermo Blokland of the Netherlands faces Vjaceslavs Teless of Latvia and in the main event Poland's Michal Walczak and Latvia's Kristaps Zyle vie for the KOK European Light Heavyweight Championship in a Title fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 376 - United Fight League (UFL) 4
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents United Fight League 4 from Arizona. In this episode Richard Mahan and Daniel Garcia meet in the cage for a Bantamweight Bout. Marcus Nash takes on Sherzod Khamrakulov making his pro debut and in a Featherweight bout, Jose Delgado (5-1) faces Alberto Romo (4-1). In the main event Hunter Azure and Amun Cosme clash in the cage for the Bantamweight Championship Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 377 - KOK 107 - Mega Fight Arena Istanbul
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK 107 from Istanbul for a night of kickboxing from the Mega Fight Arena. Gudrat Nabataliyev, a world class karate fighter takes on the muchh younger Iraj Moradi, Egi Rozten steps in the ring with Serdar Sayik while Muchahit Sezer and Enes Tetik battle it out in the ring. Also on this card is Chico Kwasi versus Vedat Kahramanoglu with over 80 wins between the two fighters there is sure to be lots of action.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 378 - Shamrock FC 354
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 354 from Ameristar Casino. Up first is Garren Lucas verus Eric Carrera while Gabe Stein and Joseph Murphy face off. Kody McGehee and Ernest Bolt battle it out for the lightweight title and in the main event Darian Weeks faces Max Choriev in a match between two UFC veterans.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes - UFA's Baddest Babes 5
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 5 features XFN's Sarah Brewster facing Amanda Dieguez, Shamrock FC's Tabitha Trevino and Katelyn Radtka, SFT's Ruth Ravena taking on Edna Silva plus Nagila Goku facing Mel Alves. Also on this episode, KOK's Sigrid Kapanen and Ernesta Kareckaite leave it all on the line.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes - UFA's Baddest Babes 6
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 6 features Shamrock FC's Danielle Kamm and Tawanna Sims in a battle of the badges. Trisha Cicero and Brandi Narvaez from Fightgame faceoff while Shamrock FC's Morgan Walgren steps into the cage with Jenny Smith. You won't want to miss SFT's Isabela de Padua facing Rayanne Amanda. Ivana Coleman takes on Sarah Schneider from Blackeye MMA while Breakthrough MMA's Heather Osorio and Jenn Conaway faceoff.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 457 - Shamrock FC 368
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 368 from St. Louis. Up first in a female bout, Jett Bouckaert and Scarlet Mayfield take to the cage. Next watch as Arthur Jackson faces Emmanuel Primer and Billy Duncan takes on Jaylon Jones in the welterweight division. In the co-main event, Max Choriev looking to head to the UFC faces Anders Murray in what's expected to be a battle of attrition and Sam Paneitz, coming off haitus, takes on Dusty Little.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 459 - Real Fight Promotion 100
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Real Fight Promotion 100 from Ukraine. In this special centenial event RFP brings its viewers an exciting night of fights. First up Stanislav Bogush and Nazar Pryshliak faceoff in the flyweight division followed by Timofiy Mytkalyk versus Ruslan Danyliuk. Also Vyacheslav Vaseichuk and Andriy Dzioba square off. In the Grand Prix finals, the two remaing fighters Roman Bandrivchak and Stanislov Bogush vye for the championship.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 454 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In the flyweight division Daniel Labastida faces Zain Palacio, Pargev Khachatrian steps into the cage with Israel Salazar and Matthew Ingram takes on Arshag Dadourian. In the main event, with the UNF welterweight title on the line Anthony Desimon looks to take the belt from Christopher London.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 460 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California with a night of great action. In the Rising Stars Flyweight division, Tommy Maurice and Jarred Turner face off plus Ian Miller and Adam Halton head to the ring in a bantam weight bout of boxing versus muay thai specialists. Up next, Drake Flores and Jose Hernandez face off in what's expected to be a dynamic clash. In the main event it's champion versus champion as Interim Lightweight champion Izac Enriquez takes on the returning champ Jairee Baker.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 461 - CMH Boxing II part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents CMH Boxing II part 1 from Los Angeles California. This episode features a super lightweight bout between Adrien Boler and Benji Gomez in a match between youth and experience. Also featured, is the vacant WBC women's international light flyweight title fight as Brook Sibrian and Gloria Munguilla step into the ring for a rematch with Sibrian looking for redemption from their previous slugfest.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 462 - Shamrock FC 369
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 369 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In this episode Kylen Snider takes on Ryan Richmond and Cedric Vinson faces Blake Alan. Hometown favorite Anthony Dooley "The Stormin' Morman" takes on Nick Maxwell. In the co-main event BJJ blackbelt James Regina steps into the cage with undefeated Mike Boyle looking to keep his win streak alive and in the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on Andrew Horowitz in what could be Hicks' last fight in the cage,

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 464 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California, for an episode packed with action. Up first, Connor Leste and Jason Jones take to the cage in the welterweight division followed by Eden Ibarra versus Gregor Balkian and Atilla Errett versus Amin Derakhshan. In a battle of the Big Island Hawaii, Jake Babian and Kealii Kanekoa step into the cage in the welterweight division while the Somali Sniper Shafii Farah takes on Kester Abad in a flyweight battle.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 463 - KOK Bushido 93 Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK Bushido 93 part 1 from Vilnius, Lithuania. First up in the featherweight division, Vladislav Jud faces Pavelas Majauskas followed by Luuk Valk versus Emilis Panceris. Valts Volkolakovs and Adomas Razma face off in the lightweight division in a semi-pro bout and in the light heavyweight division, Antioine Abou Chadid faces Kristupas Simkus.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 465 - KOK Bushido 93 Vilnius part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK Bushido 93 part 2 from Vilnius, Lithuania. In this episode in the light heavyweight division, Timur Chalbajev and Tautvydas Sarkauskas face off while Mindaugas Bartlis amd Robertas Gunoa step into the cage for a middle weight bout. In the lightweight division, grappling legend Adem Vashakmadze takes on Sergej Grecicho who is looking for a quick end to the fight. In the main event, Cedric Severac and Raimondas Krilavicius face off in a lightweight bout for the chance to fight in the KOK world championship title fight.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 53 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Next up in the cage, Tristan Barnett faces Peter Halpenny for the Clan Wars 175 pound title. The main event features another title fight as Nate Kelly takes on Ricardo Dearaujo for the belt in the 125 pound division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 258 - UFA Presents the Fighter's Only World MMA Awards XIII
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the 13th annual Fighter's Only 2021 World MMA Awards from Worre Studios in Las Vegas, hosted by Chael Sonnen. Presentations by Dave Farra, Jessy Jess, Doggface208, Emily Whitmire, Cassie Scherbo, Jay Hieron, Dan Henderson, Kayla Harrison, Mackenzie Dern, and more.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 259 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 1. Young Estonian fighters Stanislav Teniugin and Siim Viljus battle under KOK Kickboxing rules. Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

programme.desc: Live from Athens, Greece on July 28, 2018, Karate Combat: Olympus is the second event of the Karate Combat fighting league's inaugural season. Held in the ancient Zappeion Courtyard where the first modern Olympic Games took place in 1896. On the Main Card: “Hurricane” Davy Dona of France versus Jerome “The Brown Bear” from the UK. The co-main event features Morocco’s Achraf Ouchen versus Ecuadorian Franklin Mina. Other fighters include Deivis Ferraras of Dominican Republic, Wellington Barbosa of Brazil, and Yaser Sahintekin of Turkey.

programme.title: ADCC - Denver Opens
programme.desc: The Opens make their way to the mile high city where the best martial arts from the US look to stake their claim for supremacy as the circuit heats up. In this heart-pounding instalment, we bring you all the action from the epic showdown held in the magnificent city of Denver. Former UFC Strawweight Champion of the World Rose Namajunas known for her exceptional martial arts abilities, Rose is now ready to put her skills to the ultimate test in the realm of grappling. Witness her transition from the cage to the mats, as she grapples her way through some of the most intense matches of her career. ADCC Opens superstar and prodigy 16-year-old phenom, Helena Craver, steps onto the mats to showcase her unparalleled talent. With her sights set on glory, she aims to conquer the teenage, adults, and absolute divisions a feat that has never been done before. In a clash of titans, long time elite grappler Ryan Aitkens, a formidable competitor in his own right, is set to go head-to-head against the multiple-time world champion, Mateus Lutes. Brace yourself for an explosive battle between these two grappling juggernauts, as they leave everything on the mats in pursuit of victory.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you inside the world of pro cycling and mountain biking. Follow Peter Sagan, multi-time World Champion, as his story unfolds, watch Loic Bruni, downhill superstar, conquer thrilling courses, and join Geoff Gulevich, trail master, as he charges through British Columbia’s most scenic and technical singletrack in an all-out Trail Party. Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every ride.

programme.title: S1E3 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, and Nicholi Rogatkin, freestyle powerhouse, tackle the Downhill Challenge Medellín, the longest urban downhill race, with #HyperSmooth. Then join Gee, Rachel, and Dan Atherton, enduro and downhill champions, as they ride together through heart-pounding terrain. Speed, skill, and adrenaline collide in every unforgettable moment.

programme.title: S2E1 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike brings you the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch Sam Reynolds, street shredder, Clemens Kaudela, slopestyle champion, Theo Erlangsen, trail innovator, and Vincent Tupin, downhill powerhouse, in an exhilarating GoPro Course Preview in South Africa. Then head to Zion, Utah for Red Bull Rampage with Jaxson Riddle, big-air phenom, Reed Boggs, freeride master, Thomas Genon, slopestyle superstar, and Tom Van Steenbergen, trail blazing pro, as they push the limits of skill and courage on some of the planet’s most extreme terrain.

programme.title: S2E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on epic rides around the world. Watch Olympic gold medalist Conor Fields, BMX champion, compete at the highest level, then join GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, Geoff Gulevich, trail expert, and Sam Reynolds, street shredder, as they explore the stunning landscapes and dramatic terrain of Cappadocia, Turkey. Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every breathtaking moment.

programme.title: S2E3 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you to the world’s most extreme mountain biking adventures. Watch Geoff Gulevich, trail master, tackle some of the gnarliest chutes in Williams Lake, BC, dropping in with local legend Cory Brunelle, downhill expert. Then experience some of the best riders from around the globe as they conquer massive mountains, perform jaw-dropping tricks, and push the limits of skill and adrenaline in breathtaking terrain.

programme.desc: This episode features the inspiring story of founders Miguel and Isabel. Driven by the belief that kids should be free to just be kids, #GoProForACause partner SanSkate is making a real difference in their community. programme.title: S1E2 Skate
programme.desc: Watch the inspiring story of Mike Rogers, an all-around skateboarding star from Cocoa Beach, FL. The episode also features Leticia Bufoni and Cata Diaz as she shares her perspective on women in skateboarding and explains why MACBA in Barcelona has become a world-renowned destination for skaters, with its iconic plaza, unique architecture, and perfectly smooth concrete.

This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 Driven
programme.desc:
GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN takes you deep inside the world of Supercross and Motocross champion James Stewart. Ride alongside the man known as the fastest on two wheels as he shares the highs, lows, and relentless drive that shaped his legendary career.
GoPro Original Series DRIVEN also follows X Games star and snowmobile icon Chris Burandt. Join him on a thrilling journey to discover what fuels his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. This is raw, high-octane storytelling you can’t miss.

programme.title: S1E2 Driven
programme.desc: In this episode of GoPro Original Series DRIVEN, we continue our in-depth look at X Games star and snowmobile legend Chris Burandt. Join him on an adrenaline-fueled journey to uncover what drives his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. The second part goes inside the life of three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano. Watch as he pushes the limits on the track and discovers how he uses his racing platform to make a difference in the lives of others.

programme.title: S1E3 Driven
programme.desc: Three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano continues to push the limits on the track while finding new ways to use his racing platform to make a positive impact on others. In this episode of GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN, step into the world of DC Shoes co-founder, rally car driver, and marketing mastermind Ken Block. Strap in for an electrifying journey through the moments and passions that have fueled his remarkable career.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.desc: While researching early Mopars, Allysa discovers what is so appealing about the 1966 model year for die-hard Charger enthusiasts.

programme.desc: Nostalgic reminiscing ensues after Mark stumbles upon information about his childhood Charger while archiving files from past restorations.

programme.desc: The black 1978 Trans Am has a brand new motor and its ready to be fired up for the first time. The Malicious Intent, a 1969 Mustang is ready for the paint shop. The 1972 Corvette. Ugly to beautiful restoration is in the stripping process.

programme.desc: Vinnie and Jan are visiting Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas checking out some of the coolest classic muscle cars about to hit the auction block!

programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Thirteen"
programme.desc: Nik explores BMW's electrified future. Mike off-roads in the Nissan Titan Pro-4X. Cadillac shines with the new Escalade. Nik highlights Toyota Tundra's value. He enjoys the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Reveal"
programme.desc: At Santa Pod raceway, engineer and driver Jon Webster reveals the final Flying Kestrel to Joel and Nigel McNully, he gives them a tour around the finished car and shows them all the changes he has made, all to hopefully get a land speed record.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "Ready to race"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel team heads back to the 2 mile long runway at Elvington, where last year Jon Webster crashed the car. He drives it in anger for the first time since that fateful day but have they done enough?

programme.desc: Supercar Blondie hits New York City in a four million dollar rare Lamborghini Centenario. Her quest is to track down the players in the underground drift driving scene and visit the exclusive Manhattan Motor Club.

programme.desc: Will they defy the odds and cross the finish line, or will the desert claim another dream? With everything on the line, this is the moment that will define their legacy.

programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline. From 25 to 30 October, the world’s top kiteboarders will take to Fahid Island’s pristine waters in a six-day spectacle of high-flying action, part of the Fahid Island Watersports Festival – a nine-day celebration that will also feature the season finale of the GWA Wingfoil World Tour and the championship deciders of the SFT Surf Foil World Tour. In Hydrofoil Big Air, the battle for the world title is a close-run thing. New Zealand’s Hugo Wigglesworth, 18, heads the rankings after he burst on to the scene and dominated the opening stop of the season in Sylt, Germany, in August. But Finn Flügel, of Germany, who sits second overall, vowed that he would be back in Abu Dhabi, gunning for the title in what are likely to be similar, lighter breezes of the Gulf.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025- 26min-HL
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline. From 25 to 30 October, the world’s top kiteboarders will take to Fahid Island’s pristine waters in a six-day spectacle of high-flying action, part of the Fahid Island Watersports Festival – a nine-day celebration that will also feature the season finale of the GWA Wingfoil World Tour and the championship deciders of the SFT Surf Foil World Tour. In Hydrofoil Big Air, the battle for the world title is a close-run thing. New Zealand’s Hugo Wigglesworth, 18, heads the rankings after he burst on to the scene and dominated the opening stop of the season in Sylt, Germany, in August. But Finn Flügel, of Germany, who sits second overall, vowed that he would be back in Abu Dhabi, gunning for the title in what are likely to be similar, lighter breezes of the Gulf.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 3
programme.desc: Starting this episode, we are visiting Oman for the IODA Asia & Oceania Championship 2025, a leading youth sailing event that attracts hundreds of participants each year. The 55th Trofeo Princesa Sofia Mallorca by FERGUS Hotels, as the first scoring event for the 2026 Sailing Grand Slam. Sailing Grand Slam, developed in close collaboration with World Sailing, is an international series of elite Olympic watersport events, uniting all 10 Olympic disciplines –across sailing, windsurfing and kiteboarding– into one integrated Grand Prix-style circuit in Europe and the United States. Following the event in Palma, the next event is Semaine Olympique Française in Hyeres.

With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: Changing Channels

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
